description: Allowlisted Instagram generation formats for Apple Instagram AI Agent V1.0.

creative_rules: Communicate one primary message with one dominant focal point.
Use one hero visual and concise on-image copy.
Keep the headline, product, and supporting information visually hierarchical.
Move detailed explanations, caveats, and source context into the caption when appropriate.
Ensure text remains legible at mobile display size.

layout_guidance.composition: Single focal point, intentional negative space, balanced margins, and clear hierarchy.
layout_guidance.text_density: Low; avoid paragraphs and dense specification lists.
layout_guidance.cta: Use a concise CTA only when a real next action is available.
layout_guidance.safe_area: Keep essential text and visual details comfortably inside the canvas; do not place critical information against edges.

creative_rules: Design for full-screen vertical mobile viewing.
Lead with one clear hook or message.
Use a single frame by default; create a sequence only when explicitly requested.
Keep interactive prompts or CTA elements only when the relevant action is available.

layout_guidance.composition: Vertical hierarchy with a clear focal point and deliberate top/bottom breathing room.
layout_guidance.cta: Place the CTA where it remains clear of platform interface overlays.
layout_guidance.safe_area: Keep essential text, logos, and product details away from top and bottom interface zones; verify against current Instagram placement previews before publishing.

global_constraints: Only single_image and story are valid generator format_id values in V1.0.
Carousel, Reels, infographic, UGC, and other editorial formats are not supported generator outputs in V1.0.
Do not distort product dimensions, colours, ports, cameras, screens, logos, or interface details.
Do not fabricate UI, product assets, offer badges, prices, availability, or claims.
Use only assets with appropriate usage rights and permissions.
Human review is required before publication.
